tagline.zh: 把弹簧物理采样编译成 CSS linear() 关键帧:JS 采样一次,浏览器插值一万次——overshoot 原样保留,零运行时,Baseline 2023-12。
tagline.en: Compile spring physics into CSS linear() keyframes: JS samples once, the browser interpolates forever — overshoot preserved verbatim, zero runtime, Baseline since 2023-12.

origin.zh: MDN linear()(Baseline 2023-12 起全浏览器可用)+ Jake Archibald 的 linear() easing generator:此前 web 只有 cubic-bezier,无法表达 bounce/spring/elastic;生成器把 JS/SVG 缓动函数采样编译为 linear() 控制点(调研 04§1.2、09§1.6);css-easing-2 规范中不存在 spring()。
origin.en: MDN linear() (Baseline across browsers since 2023-12) + Jake Archibald's linear() easing generator: before it, the web only had cubic-bezier and could not express bounce/spring/elastic; the generator samples and compiles a JS/SVG easing function into linear() control points (research 04 §1.2, 09 §1.6); no spring() exists in css-easing-2.

effect.zh: 弹簧刚度 k(demo 以 mass=1 半隐式欧拉积分采样:a = −k(x−1) − c·v)。调大频率更高、到位更快、overshoot 更尖锐。默认 170 是社区常见弹簧手感值(react-spring 的传统默认),调研未证实为官方数值——linear() 本身没有官方默认参数。
effect.en: Spring stiffness k (the demo samples via semi-implicit Euler integration at mass=1: a = −k(x−1) − c·v). Higher = faster frequency, faster arrival, sharper overshoot. The default 170 is a common community feel value (react-spring's traditional default), unverified as official — linear() itself has no official default parameters.

effect.zh: 阻尼系数 c:调大振荡更早被吸收,超过临界转入过阻尼(无 overshoot 的平滑逼近);调小振荡次数增多。默认 26 是社区常见弹簧手感值(react-spring 的传统默认),调研未证实为官方数值。
effect.en: Damping coefficient c: higher absorbs oscillation sooner, past critical it turns overdamped (a smooth approach with no overshoot); lower multiplies the oscillations. The default 26 is a common community feel value (react-spring's traditional default), unverified as official.

note.zh: linear() 自 2023 年 12 月起 Baseline widely available(MDN,调研 04§1.2);demo 的采样与 Douglas-Peucker 抽稀是普通 JS,无兼容性风险;旧浏览器会忽略整个 animation-timing-function,可先写 cubic-bezier 再写 linear() 兜底。
note.en: linear() is Baseline widely available since December 2023 (MDN, research 04 §1.2); the demo's sampling and Douglas-Peucker simplification are plain JS with no compatibility risk; older browsers drop the whole animation-timing-function, so declare a cubic-bezier fallback before the linear() value.

fallback.zh: linear() 不被识别时整个 timing-function 失效——先写 cubic-bezier 回退再写 linear(…) 声明;prefers-reduced-motion 时 demo 不播动画、直出终态,但生成结果照常更新(条目价值在产物本身)。
fallback.en: When linear() is not recognized the whole timing-function is dropped — declare a cubic-bezier fallback before the linear(…) value; under prefers-reduced-motion the demo skips playback and shows the end state while the generated output still updates (the entry's value is the artifact itself).

use.zh: 想把弹簧手感导出为纯 CSS(不携带 JS 库)的场景——产物可烧进任意框架
use.en: Exporting a spring feel as pure CSS (no JS library shipped) — the artifact drops into any framework

use.zh: 需要 overshoot/回弹但 cubic-bezier 表达不了的曲线
use.en: Curves needing overshoot/bounce that cubic-bezier cannot express

use.zh: 与 CSS transition 生态混用、或要在 keyframes 外复用同一曲线的项目
use.en: Projects mixing with the CSS transition ecosystem or reusing one curve across keyframes

avoid.zh: 需要可打断并从当前速度继续的弹簧——linear() 是固定曲线,没有速度状态;要交互弹簧用 Motion useSpring
avoid.en: Springs that must be interruptible and continue from current velocity — linear() is a fixed curve with no velocity state; use Motion's useSpring for interactive springs

avoid.zh: 运行时改参数的实时弹簧——每次改动都要重新采样编译;先离线烘好再上线
avoid.en: Live springs retuned at runtime — every change requires resampling; bake offline, ship static

avoid.zh: 对手势跟手/惯性释放场景——那是 inertia/物理弹簧的领地(见本分类其余条目)
avoid.en: Gesture tracking / inertia release — that is physics spring / inertia territory (see sibling entries)

a11y.zh: 生成产物用于位移类动画时是前庭触发源,必须配 prefers-reduced-motion 降级(直出终态或改为 opacity 溶解);弹簧的 overshoot 是视觉强调,不承载信息——关键状态变化不能只靠这段动画传达。
a11y.en: When the artifact drives displacement, it is a vestibular trigger and must pair with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback (final state, or an opacity cross-fade); the spring's overshoot is visual emphasis, not information — key state changes must never ride on this animation alone.

goal.zh: 把参数快照的弹簧(stiffness/damping,mass=1)采样编译成 linear() 关键帧文本并直接用于 animation-timing-function,demo 用纯 CSS animation 播放并实时显示生成的 CSS 代码。
goal.en: Sample the snapshot spring (stiffness/damping, mass=1) into linear() keyframes and apply them as animation-timing-function; the demo plays a pure CSS animation and shows the generated CSS live.

acceptance.zh: 按弹簧物理方程采样(mass=1,a = −k(x−1) − c·v),采样到静止为止
acceptance.en: Sample by the spring ODE (mass=1, a = −k(x−1) − c·v) until settled

acceptance.zh: 进度值允许越界(overshoot 保留),数值圆整 3 位小数(生成器默认 round=3)
acceptance.en: Progress values may exceed [0,1] (overshoot preserved), rounded to 3 decimals (generator default round=3)

acceptance.zh: 产物形如 linear(0, 0.012 3.1%, …, 1),时间位置不均匀的点补 % 停留点
acceptance.en: Output like linear(0, 0.012 3.1%, …, 1), with % stops wherever the time spacing is uneven

acceptance.zh: demo 用纯 CSS animation 播放,并提供一条 ease 对照轨道
acceptance.en: The demo plays a pure CSS animation with an ease-timed comparison track

acceptance.zh: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时不播动画直出终态,生成文本照常更新
acceptance.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, skip playback and show the end state; the generated text still updates
